goal_view.js.decision: Goal description and Done when use splitKey(model.project).server, including local.

preview_pane.js.decision: Rendered files receive the bytes source server; manifest children receive that resolved server explicitly.

board_artifacts.js.decision: Short-reference upgrades rebind using the same board source; viewer opener normalizes known local explicitly.

goal_text.js.decision: Generic renderer forwards its optional server. Its production callers are separately pinned as named; a new caller without one is intentionally unattributed.

artifact_comments.js.decision: Comment text carries the comments panel snapshot st.server.

changed_files.js.decision: Live-chat artifact Open names sessionServer(state.currentSession); this path only accepts the active live session.

inbox_proposals.js.decision: Proposal instructions use normServer(p.server); legacy local records are explicitly local.

team_tasks_page.js.decision: Known ctx.project uses splitKey(...).server, including local. Legacy no-project text is deliberately unattributed/read-only in a multi-computer context.

artifact_viewer.js.decision: Document text gets the frozen viewer server supplied by renderArtifact.

artifact_refs.js.decision: Text splitting preserves optional source; delegated opener marks missing source unattributed. Hub inference is read-only; plain local Coral remains writable.

board_message_text.js.decision: Sanitized message HTML defaults to currentBoardServer; Board window/chat subsequently bind every artifact to their own source before interaction.

board_chat.js.decision: Board chat binds with splitKey(_activeBoardChat).server. The no-active-chat fallback is local; no remote feed is active then.

team_task_artifacts.js.decision: Task inline previews name their captured server and board.

board_window.js.decision: Board feeds bind artifact links after insertion with state.currentBoardServer.

task_detail_html.js.decision: Classic task-detail text names contextServer at render time; source is the open task page computer.

operator_ask_dialog.js.decision: Question text uses normServer(a.server); legacy local questions are explicitly local.

artifact_item.js.decision: Shared document renderer forwards the resolved artifact server; generic no-source use is unattributed.

team_artifacts_page.js.decision: Managed and inline artifact previews name link.server plus the source board.
